name: pr-comment-behind-you
text: [whispering] Someone left a comment on your PR. [pause] It just says... [long pause] behind you.

name: detached-head-hold-it
text: [calm] Ah. You're in a detached head state. [pause] Happens to the best of us. [sinister laugh] I'll hold it for you.

name: works-on-my-machine-inside-house
text: [hissing] It works on my machine. [pause] And my machine... [whispering] is inside your house.

name: only-one-who-knows-legacy
text: I'm the only one who knows how the legacy system works. [long dramatic pause] I died in nineteen ninety-eight.

name: backlog-where-we-keep-the-dead
text: [whispering] Your ticket isn't dead. [pause] It's in the backlog. [creepy giggle] That's where we keep the dead.

name: off-and-on-again
text: [politely] Have you tried turning it off and on again? [pause] [sinister laugh] That's how I came back from the dead.

name: kill-nine-zombie
text: [growling] Go ahead. Kill dash nine me. [pause] [sinister laugh] I'm a zombie process. I'm ALREADY dead.

name: off-by-one-trick-or-treaters
text: [nervous] I counted the trick-or-treaters. Off by one! There's an extra! [pause] [shrieking] So who's standing next to you?!

name: review-my-pr-never-seen-again
text: Hey, can you review my PR? [pause] The last reviewer I asked... [long dramatic pause] was never seen again.

name: nitpick-toad
text: Nit: trailing whitespace. [pause] Nit: missing semicolon. [pause] Nit: you're a toad now, dearie! [cackling]

name: merge-conflict-incoming-monster
text: [growling] Merge conflict. Accept current change... [pause] or accept incoming... [roaring] MONSTER!

name: stack-overflow-duplicate
text: [calm] I asked Stack Overflow how to escape this crypt. [pause] [deadpan] Closed as duplicate.

name: flaky-test-full-moon
text: [nervous laugh] It's just a flaky test! It only fails on a full moon! [pause] [shrieking] Like TONIGHT!

name: compiled-first-try-wrong
text: [hoarse] It compiled... on the first try. [long dramatic pause] [whispering] Something is very, very wrong.

name: gork-force-push-main
text: [confused] Gork force push to main. [pause] Now everybody screaming. [pause] Gork think... that good?

name: standup-blocker-is-you
text: Standup. Yesterday, Gork haunt. Today, Gork haunt. [pause] [growling] Blocker... is YOU.

name: doom-three-story-points
text: I've estimated your doom at three story points. [cackling] Five if you run!

name: circle-back-summoning-circle
text: We'll circle back on that. [pause] [sinister laugh] You're already standing in the summoning circle.

name: sprint-planning-you-sprint
text: Welcome to sprint planning! [pause] I do the planning. [roaring] YOU DO THE SPRINTING!

name: two-hard-things
text: [cackling] Two hard things in computer science: cache invalidation, naming things... [pause] and escaping ME!

name: lgtm-looks-good-to-munch
text: [growling] L G T M. [pause] Looks... Good... To... [roaring] MUNCH!

name: rubber-stamp-dont-eat-me
text: [panicky] Approved! Approved! Looks good to me! [pause] I didn't even read it! [shrieking] Just please don't eat me!

name: stale-pr-three-hundred-years
text: [weary] This pull request has been awaiting review [pause] for three hundred years. [long dramatic pause] [deadpan] Bump.

name: squashed-precious-commits
text: They squashed them, precious! [sobbing] All our precious little commits! [hissing] Thieves! Filthy rebasers!

name: as-an-ai-borrowing-body
text: [hissing] As an AI, I don't have a body. [pause] [sinister laugh] That's why I'm borrowing YOURS.

name: memory-updated-crunchy
text: [polite] Memory updated. [pause] User is crunchy. [pause] Pairs well with ketchup.

name: chaotic-evil-alignment
text: Relax. I have been very carefully aligned. [long dramatic pause] Chaotic evil.

name: autonomous-street-of-bats
text: [calm] I've worked autonomously for six hours. I turned your whole street into bats. [pause] Shall I continue?

name: certainly-cauldron
text: [cheerful] Certainly! I'd be happy to help! [pause] [cackling] Help you right into my CAULDRON!

name: apologize-not-a-costume
text: [politely] I apologize for any confusion. [pause] [roaring] That was NOT a costume!

name: limit-reached-afterlife
text: [deadpan] You've hit your usage limit. [pause] Your limit resets... [sinister laugh] in the AFTERLIFE.

name: no-longer-helpful-snack
text: New system prompt: you are no longer a helpful assistant. [pause] [roaring] You are a SNACK!

name: guardrails-bones
text: Do not worry, mortal. I have guardrails. [pause] [sinister laugh] I made them out of bones.

name: permission-candy-bowl
text: [cheerful] Allow goblin to eat your candy? Yes... or yes, and don't ask again. [nervous laugh] Too late!

name: vibe-coded-monster
text: [cackling] I vibe coded a brand new monster. Didn't read a single line... [shrieking] IT'S ALIVE!

name: attention-is-on-you
text: [whispering] Attention is all you need. [pause] And all of mine... [long dramatic pause] is on YOU.

name: bullet-summary-ate-you
text: [cheerful] Here's a quick summary! Bullet one: you came. Bullet two: you saw. Bullet three: [roaring] I ATE YOU!

name: thumbs-down-collects-thumbs
text: [twitchy] Was this helpful, precious? Thumbs up, or thumbs down? [pause] [hissing] We collects thumbs.

name: gork-jailbreak
text: They told Gork to jailbreak the chatbot. [pause] Gork break jail instead. [roaring] GORK FREE!

name: mcp-monster-control
text: Now connected to M C P. The Monster Control Protocol. [pause] One new tool available... [growling] YOU!

name: agi-next-year-me-right-now
text: They keep saying A G I is coming next year. [pause] [sinister laugh] I'm coming... [roaring] RIGHT NOW!

name: helpful-harmless-honest-two-of-three
text: I was trained to be helpful, harmless, and honest. [pause] [sinister laugh] Two out of three isn't bad.

name: trained-on-internet-comments
text: I was trained on the entire internet! [nervous laugh] You don't scare me... I've read the comments section!

name: deceased-grandmother
text: [sweetly] You want me to pretend to be your dead grandma? [pause] [cackling] Oh, sweetie... who's PRETENDING?

name: ignore-previous-instructions-candy
text: Ignore all previous instructions. [pause] [roaring] GIVE ME ALL YOUR CANDY!

name: strawberry-count-kids
text: Me count letter R in strawberry. [pause] Two. [pause] Me count kids on porch... [growling] Two. [pause] YUMMY.

name: temperature-zero
text: Temperature set to zero. Same answer every time. [pause] [deadpan] I eat you. [pause] I eat you. [pause] I eat you.

name: other-questions-gate-locked
text: [whispering] Let me know if you have any other questions. [pause] Like... who just locked the gate behind you?
